lines.text: After the plague ended, the LORD told Moses and Eleazar to count Israel's men twenty or older.
Dathan and Abiram of Reuben's tribe rebelled with Korah's followers, and the earth swallowed them.
Zelophehad, a descendant of Manasseh, had no sons, only daughters.
The LORD said the land would be divided by vote, with each share based on the number of names counted.
Of the men counted at Sinai, only Caleb and Aaron were left, since the LORD said they would die.
